categories.name: Spoofing
categories.outcome: Attacker pretends to be another user or component (stolen/forged identity).

categories.name: Tampering
categories.outcome: Unauthorized modification of data at rest or in transit.

categories.name: Repudiation
categories.outcome: Actor denies an action and the system cannot prove otherwise.

categories.name: Denial of Service
categories.outcome: Service degraded or denied to legitimate users.

categories.name: Elevation of Privilege
categories.outcome: Actor gains permissions beyond their authorized role.
